metadata.note: Ordered fault-tolerance ladder feeding the Q-Day error-correction component. Status is achieved, partial, or not_yet. The tier is the count of consecutive achieved rungs from rung 1; partial rungs add half a point to the score but do not advance the tier. See METHODOLOGY.md.

rungs.label: Below-threshold error correction
rungs.criterion: Logical error rate falls as code distance grows (quantum memory)
rungs.evidence: Google Willow: distance-3 to 5 to 7 surface codes, logical error roughly halved at each step (Nature)

rungs.label: Fault-tolerant logical magic states
rungs.criterion: Magic (T) states prepared inside an error-correcting code with error below the physical gate error
rungs.evidence: Quantinuum: logical magic state infidelity 7e-5 (June 2025). QuEra/Harvard/MIT: logical-level magic state distillation (Nature, July 2025). Google: magic state cultivation on Willow, 99.99% fidelity, 8% of attempts kept, color-to-surface code grafting (Science, Oct 2026)

rungs.label: Break-even logical non-Clifford gate in a circuit
rungs.criterion: A logical non-Clifford gate, fed by magic states, beats the physical gate's error rate inside a fault-tolerant circuit
rungs.evidence: Quantinuum H1-1: break-even two-qubit logical non-Clifford gate (infidelity 2e-4) and the first circuit using a fully fault-tolerant universal gate set. Partial: shown in a small error-detecting code with post-selection, not a scalable error-correcting code

rungs.label: Algorithm-grade magic states
rungs.criterion: T states at or below 1e-6 error from cultivation (distance 5 or higher) or distillation, at a usable acceptance rate
rungs.evidence: Best demonstrated as of Oct 2026: about 7e-5 (Quantinuum, 2025) and 1e-4 (Google cultivation, 2026). Shor-scale circuits need far lower error

rungs.label: Magic-state-fed logical computation
rungs.criterion: At least 100 logical non-Clifford gates executed in one error-corrected circuit with real-time decoding
rungs.evidence: No public demonstration found as of Oct 2026

rungs.label: CRQC-class fault tolerance
rungs.criterion: About 1,000+ logical qubits with T-state throughput sufficient for ECDLP-256 or RSA-2048 (Google's Mar 2026 estimate needs about 0.5M T states per second for a 9-minute ECDLP-256 run)
